verdict.rationale: Quo publishes downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 documents for its Public API: a dated-version spec (2026-03-30) is linked from the docs pages, and a v1 spec is linked from the docs llms.txt. The probe's 404s at conventional paths do not contradict this, because the specs are hosted on S3. missing for 10: discoverability at standard well-known paths (openapi.json/.well-known all 404, and the files sit in an S3 bucket still named openphone), independent hands-on corroboration that the files download and validate.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
